name: smwsprites-floor-button
title: Floor Button
description:
A custom floor button switch sprite I made (flatter than a P-switch) that includes several features:
  • Flip on/off switch (including toggling and 1-way)
  • Flip blue/silver P-switch (including toggling and 1-way)
  • Flip Custom triggers (exanimation, toggle and 1-way)
  • Flip switch palace flags (toggle and 1-way)
  • Mario vs Donkey Kong colored switches (exanimation's manuel triggers)
  • Emit signal that does something based on what block the signal travels into


Basically, this is the custom sprite version of my 16x8 block switch I made long ago.

Changelog
Code
	2026-03-29 v1.5.2
		-Made palette system for extra byte 2 to use the low 3 bits %00000XXX rather than bits 1-3 %0000XXX0. This also means you enter
		 intuitively any integer values $00-$07 rather than even values from $00-$0E. Advice taken from MarioFanGamer.
		-BinaryHex_SwitchSetting.html changes:
		--Copying extra bytes can even easily by copied on the clipboard via clicking on the "Copy" button.
		--MvDK items now say "Set MvDK colored switch to <Color>" instead of "Set to <Color>" for better context.
		-FloorButton.json no longer erroneously say "Pedestal", due to a beta version I made was a sprite that triggers by pressing up on the
		 D-pad while touching the sprite.
		-Fixed a couple of typos on image description explaining toggling the direction blocks.
